title: Loss of claimable rewards upon gauge deactivation
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `killGauge` and `reviveGauge` functions in the `Voter` contract allow the `emergencyCouncil` to deactivate and reactivate gauges. However, once a gauge is killed, its associated claimable rewards are set to zero, resulting in the permanent loss of any accumulated rewards, even if the gauge is later revived.
